verdict.rationale: What users build on this platform is stored in open, portable formats. Skills are plain directories with a `SKILL.md` file built on the open agent skills standard and checked into repos under `.agents/skills`. Plugins can use a portable Agent Plugins `plugin.json` schema, and capabilities are exposed via the open MCP and MCP Apps standards, so these artifacts can move to other compatible hosts. However, nothing documents a way to export all of a user's account data (installed plugins, connections, chat or work history) and leave. missing for 10: a documented full account data export, coverage of non-file data such as connected-service state and history, and independent or hands-on confirmation of migrating out.
